title: Claude Quickbar config
description: Buttons and nested selects shown above the Claude Code prompt by the quickbar plugin.

navigation.description: click: click to open and pick, text selection keeps working. hover: hovering opens selects and levels like a desktop menu; it makes Claude Code track the pointer, which takes over text selection in the terminal. peek (experimental): hovering a select reveals its first level with a hover style, without tracking the pointer; deeper levels open on click.

color.description: A hex color ("#2e7d4f") or a terminal color name ("red", "blueBright").

mode.description: Where the text goes: insert at the cursor (default), append to the end, or replace the whole prompt.

size.description: sm and md are one row tall, lg is three rows tall.

paddingX.description: Columns of color left and right of the label. Overrides size.

paddingY.description: Rows of color above and below the label. Overrides size.

activeColor.description: Background of the open select and of the chosen options.

text.description: A button: the text it writes. A select: an optional prefix before the chosen options' texts.

hotkey.description: Presses the button while the bar has focus (click it, or ctrl+x then tab).

send.description: true submits the prompt right away; false only writes it.

separator.description: Joins the prefix and the chosen texts of a select.

text.description: Text this choice adds. A final choice without text adds its label.

mode.description: Overrides the button's mode when this choice is the last one.

send.description: Overrides the button's send when this choice is the last one.

options.description: Opens another level of choices above this one.
